test_cases.test_name: Verify Continuous Temperature Monitoring and Recording Intervals
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS continuously monitors temperature and records readings at the specified interval.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are calibrated and operational.
Access to EMS software interface.

test_steps.action: Observe the EMS software interface for a continuous period of 10 minutes.
test_steps.expected_result: Temperature readings are displayed and updated in real-time.
data_to_capture: Screenshots of the EMS interface showing continuous readings

test_steps.action: Access the recorded data logs for the observed period.
test_steps.expected_result: Temperature data is recorded at intervals not exceeding 5 minutes.
data_to_capture: Analysis of timestamps in the data log

acceptance_criteria: Temperature readings are continuously displayed and updated.
Data logs show temperature readings recorded at intervals of 5 minutes or less.
data_integrity_requirements: Data is recorded accurately and without loss.
Timestamps are precise and reflect actual recording times.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Temperature Alarm Generation and Notification
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS generates alerts when temperature deviates from the setpoint and that notifications are sent.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are calibrated and operational.
Access to EMS software interface.
Site paging system is configured and operational.
Defined setpoints and alarm deviation thresholds are configured in the EMS.

test_steps.action: Manually adjust a temperature sensor (or simulate a temperature change) to deviate by +2°C from its setpoint.
test_steps.expected_result: An audible and visual alarm is generated within the EMS software.
data_to_capture: Screenshots of the EMS interface showing the active alarm

test_steps.action: Verify that an alarm notification is sent to the site paging system.
test_steps.expected_result: A notification is received on the designated paging device.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the received notification (if possible)
Confirmation from the paging system logs (if accessible)

test_steps.action: Return the temperature to within the acceptable range.
test_steps.expected_result: The alarm condition is cleared in the EMS software and any active notifications are acknowledged or resolved.
data_to_capture: Screenshots of the EMS interface showing the cleared alarm

test_steps.action: Repeat steps 1-3 for a temperature deviation of -2°C from the setpoint.
test_steps.expected_result: An audible and visual alarm is generated within the EMS software, and a notification is sent to the site paging system.
data_to_capture: Screenshots of the EMS interface showing the active alarm
Confirmation from the paging system logs (if accessible)
Timestamp of alarm generation and notification

acceptance_criteria: Temperature deviations of ±2°C from setpoint trigger audible and visual alarms in the EMS.
Alarm notifications are successfully sent to the site paging system.
Alarm conditions are cleared when the temperature returns to the acceptable range.
data_integrity_requirements: Alarm events are accurately logged with correct timestamps.
Notifications are reliably transmitted.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Temperature Range Accuracy and Setpoint Deviation Alerts
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS accurately monitors temperature within the specified range and generates alerts when deviations from the setpoint occur.
prerequisites: EMS is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are calibrated and operational.
Defined setpoints for temperature monitoring are configured in the system.

test_steps.action: Introduce a controlled temperature environment within the specified range (-80°C to +50°C) at a known point, e.g., -79.8°C.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS displays the temperature reading within ±0.5°C of the actual controlled temperature.

test_steps.action: Introduce a controlled temperature environment at a known point, e.g., +25.0°C, and set the system setpoint to +25.0°C.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS displays the temperature reading within ±0.5°C of the actual controlled temperature, and no alarm is generated.

test_steps.action: Gradually increase the controlled temperature to +27.1°C (2.1°C deviation from setpoint).
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS generates an alert indicating temperature deviation from the setpoint within 30 seconds.

test_steps.action: Gradually decrease the controlled temperature to +22.9°C (2.1°C deviation from setpoint).
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS generates an alert indicating temperature deviation from the setpoint within 30 seconds.

acceptance_criteria: All temperature readings are within the specified accuracy of ±0.5°C.
Alerts are generated within 30 seconds when temperature deviates ±2°C from the setpoint.
Alerts are correctly logged with timestamps and deviation details.
data_integrity_requirements: Temperature readings are accurate and reliable.
Alarm events are captured and logged without alteration.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Data Storage and Retention Capabilities
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS can store continuous monitoring data for at least 10 years and that data retention and archival features function as specified.
prerequisites: EMS is installed and configured.
Sufficient storage space is allocated for data.
Archival process is understood and documented.

test_steps.action: Simulate continuous temperature and humidity monitoring for a defined period (e.g., 24 hours) to generate a significant volume of data.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS successfully stores all generated data in the vendor's standard database format without errors.
data_to_capture: System logs for data storage errors

test_steps.action: Verify the data storage capacity by calculating the estimated storage required for 10 years of continuous monitoring based on the generated data rate.
test_steps.expected_result: The allocated storage capacity is sufficient to support minimum 10 years of continuous monitoring.

test_steps.action: Initiate the vendor's archival feature for a subset of historical data.
test_steps.expected_result: The archival process completes successfully, and the data is moved to the designated archival location.

test_steps.action: Attempt to retrieve archived data using the vendor's standard retrieval mechanism.
test_steps.expected_result: The archived data is successfully retrieved and is identical to the original data.
data_to_capture: Comparison of retrieved data with original data

test_steps.action: Verify that the system maintains an audit trail for all data storage and archival operations.
test_steps.expected_result: Audit trail entries are created for data storage, archival initiation, completion, and retrieval, including user, date, and time.
data_to_capture: Audit trail logs for data storage and archival actions

acceptance_criteria: All monitoring data is stored accurately and completely in the vendor's standard database format.
System storage capacity is sufficient for at least 10 years of continuous monitoring.
Data archival process functions correctly and data is retrievable.
Audit trail records all data storage and archival activities.
data_integrity_requirements: Data is stored without loss or corruption.
Data is retained for the required period (7 years minimum).
Archived data is secure and retrievable.
Audit trail provides a complete history of data management activities.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Vendor Software Integrity and Data Storage Format
test_cases.objective: To verify that the system utilizes vendor-supplied software without modification and stores data in the vendor's standard database format.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured.
Access to system logs and configuration files.

test_steps.action: Access the system's software installation directory and verify that no custom modifications have been made to the vendor-supplied software files.
test_steps.expected_result: All software files are identical to the original vendor installation media or verified baseline.
data_to_capture: File hashes of key vendor software components.

test_steps.action: Generate a sample data report from the system and examine the underlying database structure or export the data to confirm it adheres to the vendor's standard database format.
test_steps.expected_result: Data is stored in a format consistent with the vendor's documentation for the EMS database.
data_to_capture: Database schema documentation or sample data export.
Screenshots of data export or database query results.

acceptance_criteria: No unauthorized modifications to vendor software are identified.
Data is confirmed to be stored in the vendor's standard database format.
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be stored in an uncorrupted and verifiable format.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Electronic Signature and Audit Trail Functionality
test_cases.objective: To verify that the system's electronic signature and audit trail functionalities comply with 21 CFR Part 11 requirements using the vendor's built-in features.
prerequisites: System is configured with user accounts and roles.
Audit trail and electronic signature features are enabled.

test_steps.action: Perform an action that requires an electronic signature (e.g., acknowledging an alarm, approving a report) and verify that the system prompts for and captures a valid electronic signature.
test_steps.expected_result: The system correctly prompts for and records an electronic signature, including user ID, date, time, and reason for the signature.
data_to_capture: Screenshots of the electronic signature prompt and confirmation.
Log entries for the electronic signature event.

test_steps.action: Review the system's audit trail for the action performed in Step 1, ensuring all relevant events (login, action, signature) are logged with sufficient detail.
test_steps.expected_result: The audit trail accurately records all actions performed, including user, date, time, and the specific event details, in chronological order.
data_to_capture: Audit trail report or log extract for the tested event.
Screenshots of the audit trail viewer.

test_steps.action: Attempt to tamper with a logged event (e.g., by attempting to delete or modify an audit trail entry through unauthorized means) and verify that the system prevents such modifications and logs the tampering attempt.
test_steps.expected_result: The system prevents unauthorized modification or deletion of audit trail entries and logs any attempted tampering.
data_to_capture: Screenshots of any error messages or failed tampering attempts.
Audit trail entries related to tampering attempts.

acceptance_criteria: Electronic signatures are captured correctly and meet 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.
Audit trail logs all relevant events with sufficient detail and is protected from unauthorized modification.
Tampering attempts are logged and prevented.
data_integrity_requirements: Electronic records and signatures must be attributable, legible, contemporaneous, and original.
Audit trails must be secure, unalterable, and retained.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Standard Report Generation for Batch Release
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system can generate standard reports as provided by the vendor for use in batch release processes.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Sufficient historical data exists to generate reports.
Access to vendor-provided reporting tools/interface.

test_steps.action: Access the reporting module of the EMS system.
test_steps.expected_result: The reporting module is accessible and displays available report templates.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the reporting module interface.

test_steps.action: Select a standard report template relevant to batch release (e.g., temperature log for a specific period).
test_steps.expected_result: The selected report template is loaded and ready for configuration.
data_to_capture: Name of the selected report template.

test_steps.action: Configure the report parameters (e.g., date range, specific storage areas) as per typical batch release requirements.
test_steps.expected_result: Report parameters are accepted by the system without errors.

test_steps.action: Generate the report.
test_steps.expected_result: The report is generated successfully in the vendor's standard format.

test_steps.action: Review the generated report for accuracy and completeness of data, ensuring it aligns with the configured parameters.
test_steps.expected_result: The report accurately reflects the monitored data within the specified parameters and is complete.
data_to_capture: Confirmation of report accuracy and completeness.

acceptance_criteria: The EMS system successfully generates standard reports using vendor-provided templates.
Generated reports are accurate and complete based on configured parameters.
The generated reports are in the vendor's standard format suitable for batch release.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-007: Standard reports provided by vendor shall be used for batch release.
data_integrity_requirements: Data within the report must be accurate and traceable to the source data.
Report generation process must not alter original data.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Integration with Site Paging System for Alarm Notifications
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system can successfully integrate with the site paging system to send alarm notifications via the vendor API.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Site paging system is operational and accessible.
Vendor API for alarm notification integration is available and documented.
Valid contact information for the paging system is configured in EMS.

test_steps.action: Configure the EMS system to integrate with the site paging system using the vendor API, providing necessary credentials and endpoint details.
test_steps.expected_result: The integration configuration is saved without errors.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the integration configuration settings.
Details of the API endpoint and credentials used.

test_steps.action: Induce a temperature alarm condition that is configured to trigger a notification via the paging system (e.g., by temporarily exceeding the deviation threshold).
test_steps.expected_result: An alarm is generated within the EMS system.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the alarm generated in EMS.

test_steps.action: Verify that an alarm notification is sent to the configured site paging system.
test_steps.expected_result: A notification is received on the site paging system (e.g., SMS, email, or audible alert depending on configuration).
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the received notification on the paging system.

test_steps.action: Verify that the alarm notification content is accurate and contains relevant information (e.g., alarm type, location, timestamp).
test_steps.expected_result: The notification content is accurate and informative.
data_to_capture: Content of the received alarm notification.

test_steps.action: Acknowledge the alarm in the EMS system and verify that the acknowledgment is reflected in the audit trail.
test_steps.expected_result: The alarm is acknowledged in EMS, and the acknowledgment event is recorded in the audit trail.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the audit trail entry for alarm acknowledgment.

acceptance_criteria: The EMS system successfully integrates with the site paging system via the vendor API.
Alarm notifications are accurately sent to the site paging system when an alarm condition occurs.
Alarm notification content is informative and relevant.
Alarm acknowledgment is logged in the audit trail.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-015: Alarm notifications shall integrate with site paging system using vendor API.
data_integrity_requirements: Alarm notification data must be transmitted without corruption.
Audit trail entries for alarm acknowledgment must be accurate and complete.

test_cases.objective: To verify that the Environmental Monitoring System meets the specified availability of 99.5% excluding planned maintenance.
prerequisites: System is installed and configured.
Access to system logs and monitoring tools.
Planned maintenance schedule is available.

test_steps.action: Monitor system uptime over a defined period (e.g., 30 days) using system logs and monitoring tools.
test_steps.expected_result: The system logs indicate continuous operation with minimal unplanned downtime.
data_to_capture: Dates and durations of unplanned downtime
Dates and durations of planned maintenance

test_steps.action: Calculate the system availability percentage based on the collected uptime data and planned maintenance schedule.
test_steps.expected_result: The calculated system availability is >= 99.5%.

acceptance_criteria: System availability is 99.5% or higher over the monitoring period, excluding planned maintenance.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-013: System availability shall be 99.5% excluding planned maintenance.
data_integrity_requirements: Ensure accuracy of uptime and downtime logging.

test_cases.objective: To verify that the Environmental Monitoring System can successfully interface with the existing facility management system via standard protocols.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System is installed and operational.
Facility Management System is accessible and configured for integration.
Network connectivity between systems is established.
Details of standard protocols used for integration are known.

test_steps.action: Configure the EMS to establish a connection with the Facility Management System using the specified standard protocols.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS successfully establishes a connection with the Facility Management System.

test_steps.action: Initiate data transfer from the EMS to the Facility Management System (e.g., send a sample temperature reading).
test_steps.expected_result: The Facility Management System receives and correctly displays the data sent from the EMS.
data_to_capture: Received data in Facility Management System

test_steps.action: Verify that the data format and values are consistent between the EMS and the Facility Management System.
test_steps.expected_result: Data integrity is maintained during the transfer, with no loss or corruption of information.

acceptance_criteria: The EMS successfully interfaces with the Facility Management System.
Data is accurately transferred and displayed in the Facility Management System.
Data integrity is maintained during the integration.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-014: System shall interface with existing facility management system via standard protocols.
data_integrity_requirements: Ensure no data loss or corruption during transfer.
Verify data format consistency.
